title: Hit or miss
narration: A diagram makes the branch obvious. On a hit the stored response is served; on a miss the application computes it, the cache stores it, and then it is served.

elements.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  R[Request] --> C{In cache?}
  C -->|hit| S[Serve]
  C -->|miss| A[Compute]
  A --> W[Store]
  W --> S

elements.text: Hits are cheap. Misses pay once and then become hits.
